name: Heroes VI Memorial: Sanctuary at the Memorial Shrine
description: Takes effect when the Sanctuary town of Tears of Ashan is enabled: the Heroes VI Memorial Shrine also accepts the Sanctuary faction and can be guarded by Sanctuary creatures.
